description: Variation of Condition 43 (delivery times) to allow change in delivery times for Unit 4 Block E following planning permission 00707/714-746/P21 dated 19/06/2017 for redevelopment of the site to provide buildings of varying height between 2 and 11 storeys above ground, comprising 293 residential units (Use Class C3) and 926sqm of flexible commercial floorspace (Use Class A1-A3 / B1 / D1) together with associated car parking, cycle parking, landscaping, and infrastructure works.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby approved shall have commenced no later than the expiration of three years from the date of permission reference 00707/714-746/P21 dated 19/06/2017.

Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be implemented in strict accordance with the scheme of phasing approved under application reference 00707/714-746/P21(3,4) dated 04/05/2018.

Condition : 4 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in strict accordance with the Construction Management (CMP) and Construction Logistics Plan (CLP) approved under application reference 00707/714-746/P21(3,4) dated 04/05/2018.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 8am to 4pm on Saturdays and not at all on Sundays and Public Holidays.
Condition : 6 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in strict accordance with the Construction Travel plan approved under application reference 00707/714-746/P21(6) dated 08/01/2018.

Condition : 7 - (A)	The storage and collection of waste of the hereby approved development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the details approved under application reference 00707/714-746/P21(7) dated 29/08/2017. 
(B)	No Block shall be occupied until the waste and recycling facilities approved under Part (A) of this condition have been provided and made available for use by residents of that Block. Such facilities shall remain throughout the lifetime of the development and shall be used for no other purposes.

Condition : 8 - The hereby approved development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the details of facing materials approved under application reference 00707/714-746/P21(8) dated 11/06/2018 and maintained as such thereafter.
Condition : 9 - 90% of residential units shall meet M4(2) Building Regulations as shown on the hereby approved plans.
Condition : 10 - A minimum 10% 'Wheelchair User Dwellings' built to Building Regulations M4(3) standard shall be provided.

Condition : 11 - Acoustic insulation and means of ventilation of the hereby approved development shall only be carried out in in strict accordance with the details submitted under approved application references 00707/714-746/P21(11)  dated 29/08/2017and 00707/714-746/P21(11i,12i) dated 12/11/2019.

Condition : 12 - The hereby approved development shall only be carried out in strict accordance with the noise survey and mitigation measures approved under application references 00707/714-746/P21(12) dated 15/09/2017 and 00707/714-746/P21(11i,12i) dated 12/11/2019

Condition : 13 - The hereby approved development shall only be carried out in strict accordance with the scheme of mitigation for exposure to poor air quality approved under application references 00707/714-746/P21(13-22) dated 02/07/2019. The development shall not include biomass boilers.

Condition : 14 - The hereby approved development shall only be carried out in strict accordance with the detailed drainage designs approved under application reference 00707/714-746/P21(14-17) dated 21/08/2017.

Condition : 15 - The hereby approved development shall only be carried out in strict accordance with the drainage evidence approved under application reference 00707/714-746/P21(15-37) dated 19/07/2019 for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 16 - The hereby approved development shall only be carried out in strict accordance with the drainage strategy approved under application reference 00707/714-746/P21(14-17) dated 21/08/2017. The approved details shall be implemented prior to first occupation of any part of the development.

Condition : 17 - The hereby approved development shall only be carried out in strict accordance with the submitted details of the water impact study and recommendations contained therein approved under application reference 00707/714-746/P21(14-17) dated 21/08/2017. The approved details shall be implemented prior to first occupation of any part of the development.
Condition : 18 - Any piling must be undertaken in accordance with the terms of the approved piling method statement approved under application reference 00707/714-746/P21(18) dated 05/02/2018.

Condition : 19 - The hereby approved development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the details and validation (closure) reports submitted under application references 00707/714-746/P21(19) dated 19/09/2017; 00707/714-746/P21(19c,d) dated 31/05/2019; 00707/714-746/P21(19d) dated 02/09/2019; 00707/714-746/P21(19Di) dated 20/11/2019; 00707/714-746/P21(19Dii) dated 30/01/2020.

Condition : 20 - The hereby approved development shall be maintained in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy and as per the evidence submitted under application reference 00707/714-746/P21(20) dated 17/05/2019.

Condition : 21 - The hereby approved development shall be maintained in accordance with the approved internal water use calculations as demonstrated under application reference 00707/714-746/P21(13-22) dated 02/07/2019.

Condition : 22 - The hereby approved development shall be maintained in accordance with the sustainable sourcing of materials details approved under application reference 00707/714-746/P21(13-22) dated 02/07/2019.

Condition : 23 - The hereby approved development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the Design stage certificate and summary score sheet submitted under approved application 00707/714-746/P21(15-37) dated 19/07/2019.

Condition : 24 - Within 6 months of practical completion of the commercial floorspace, a BREEAM Post-Construction Review certificate and summary score sheet (or such equivalent standard that replaces this) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to show that an 'Excellent' (minimum score 70%) rating has been achieved.

Condition : 25 - The hard and soft landscaping of the hereby approved development shall be carried out and managed for the lifetime of the development in strict accordance with the details and management programme submitted under approved application reference 00707/714-746/P21(25) dated 30/08/2017.

All landscaping comprised in the approved details shall be carried out during the first planting and seeding seasons following completion of construction works. Any trees or shrubs planted (including any such replacements) which die within three years from the date of planting shall be replaced in the next planting season with the same species, and of comparable maturity.

Condition : 26 - The hereby approved development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the approved Biodiversity Enhancement Strategy details of application 00707/714-746/P21(26,44) dated 20/10/2017. The approved Biodiversity Enhancement Strategy shall be implemented as far as relevant prior to any building within that Phase being first occupied. Any enhancement measures shall be maintained throughout the lifetime of the development or in accordance with the strategy set out in the Landscape Management Plan.

Condition : 27 - Cycle parking for the residential use shall be provided for each Phase of the development in accordance with the approved details of application reference 00707/714/746/P21(27,28) dated 07/08/2017 before the residential units within that Phase are occupied and shall thereafter be retained solely for its designated use.

Condition : 28 - Cycle parking for the non-residential use shall be provided for each Phase of the development in accordance with the approved details of application reference 00707/714/746/P21(27,28) dated 07/08/2017 before the non-residential units within that Phase are occupied and shall thereafter be retained solely for its designated use.

Condition : 29 - Prior to the first occupation of any building within the relevant Phase, the parking, loading and turning spaces as set out in the approved plans relevant to that Phase, shall be constructed and made available for use. This shall include a minimum 20% 'active' Electric Vehicle Charging spaces and 20% 'passive' Electric Vehicle Charging spaces. The parking, loading and turning spaces shall then be retained as such and shall not be used for any other purposes thereafter.

Condition : 30 - The entrance gates of the hereby approved development shall be provided in accordance with the approved details of application reference 00707/714-746/P21(15-37) dated 19/07/2019 before the occupation of the development and shall thereafter be retained in good working order for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 31 - The loading bay(s) for the hereby approved development shall be provided in accordance with the approved details of application reference 00707/714-746/P21(15-37) dated 19/07/2019 before the occupation of the development and shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 32 - No shopping trolleys, baskets, advertisements or other commercial paraphernalia shall be stored or located on the public highway which shall be kept clear of all obstructions at all times.

Condition : 33 - Servicing shall be carried out in strict accordance with the approved internal servicing routes to the external loading bay as approved under application reference 00707/714-746/P21(15-37) dated 19/07/2019.

Condition : 34 - No loading or unloading shall take place on the public highway, including from the footway, cycle land or bus stops. Commercial deliveries shall only access the site via the western access and egress the site from the eastern access and shall be no larger than a standard 10.5m rigid lorry.

Condition : 35 - The hereby approved development shall be carried out in accordance with the Inclusive access strategy approved under application 00707/714-746/P21(35) and retained as such for the duration of the development.

Condition : 36 - Any fixed external plant shall be designed and installed to ensure that noise emanating from such plant is at least 10dB below the background noise levels when measured from the nearest sensitive receptors. Plant shall be set in from the roof boundaries by a minimum of 2m. No further fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the written prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 37 - Any external ventilation equipment for the hereby approved development shall be in strict accordance with the details approved under application reference 00707/714-746/P21(15-37) dated 19/07/2019 and shall be installed prior to the first occupation of each Phase of the development.

Condition : 38 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no windows/dormer windows other than those expressly authorised by this permission shall be constructed or installed.

Condition : 39 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings other than those expressly authorised by this permission shall be shall be carried out.

Condition : 40 - The commercial unit(s) shall be used for Class E purposes and for no other purpose (including any other purposes in the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended), or in any provision equivalent to that Schedule in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification.
Condition : 41 - The Class E (a) and E (c) use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 0600-2300.
Condition : 42 - The Class E (b) use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 0700-2300 Sun-Thurs and 0700-0000 Fri-Sat.

Condition : 43 - With the exception of Unit 4 at Block E (as shown within the red line of Site Location Plan ref. PL-101 Rev 1 received 30/11/2021), no commercial deliveries shall be taken at or dispatched from the site outside the hours of 09.00 hours to 17.30 hours Monday to Saturday nor outside the hours of 09.00 hours to 14.00 hours on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays. No commercial deliveries shall be taken at or dispatched from Unit 4 at Block E outside the hours of 07.00 hours to 17.30 hours Monday to Saturday nor outside the hours of 09.00 hours to 14.00 hours on Sundays, Bank and Public Holidays.

Condition : 44 - The hereby approved development shall be managed in strict accordance with the approved Bird Hazard Management Plan approved under application reference 00707/714-746/P21(26,44) dated 20/10/2017 for the lifetime of the development.
